biological_interpretation: ATP1A3 loss is a thalamic alpha-3 Na/K-pump RNA response coupled to cation and synaptic remodeling, not a pan-neuronal sodium-pump signature and not a full SERCA2 ER-stress state.
caveats: Atp1a2 did not show reliable neuronal self-depletion, so it is a weak negative comparator.
All evidence is steady-state mRNA rather than pump activity, ion flux, membrane potential, or calcium dynamics.
exact_observed_result: Atp1a3 perturbation in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut gave strong self-depletion and 79 non-target FDR genes, down-regulating Atp2a2/Atp2b1/Prkcg/Kcnj9/Kcnj3 while inducing Ache/Vgf/Ptpn5/Pcsk1n/Grin2a/Slc17a6; direct Atp2a2 loss induced Xbp1, Hspa5, Ddit3, Chac1, Cars and Asns instead of the Atp1a3 state.

prior_expectation.expectation: Prior Na/K-ATPase work supports alpha-3 neuronal nonredundancy; the Atp2a2 branch is a dataset-specific refinement.
